render_execution_device: physical Panther Lake NPU on Delta
findings: Thirteen delivered frames all have sole-indirect topology receipts. The complete desktop and Run are visually verified. Run first appears about 125 seconds after input.

Notepad returns 28 successful NPU results. Its previously rejected 756-by-406 first draw now completes 426 tiles and 717 provider calls. The Notepad window border and blank interior appear about 155 seconds after launch. Menus, title text and status text are absent in that received frame, so the input gate does not advance to typing.
The complete Notepad UI is only verified on the ordinary restored display. No complete Notepad interaction, typing, maximize or close result is claimed for the NPU path.

All 792 successful worker results have matching guest acknowledgements. No negative acknowledgement, raster-budget failure, queue-creation error or NPU device-loss error is logged. The worker exits 1 with socket-closed-or-timed-out during controller cleanup after the finite observation.

Four untimestamped UMD rejection rows remain in the preserved logs: draw/create_resource for Explorer and draw/update_resource for DWM, status 88760870. The observer records bounded completion and clean removal. Their exact timestamps are unavailable; successful worker execution does not erase these rejection records.

The new recorder preserves every original request in a contiguous 792-request sequence, totaling 2225653308 bytes, on physical Delta. Headers, lengths and SHA256 are verified. The repository contains metadata, not raw request buffers.

Live requests expand to 26995 provider calls. Their reported draw intervals total 138328.794 ms; compile-and-draw intervals total 328856 ms. The difference includes pipeline lookup, setup/cache loading and other wrapper work, and is not a measurement of pure compiler time or pure NPU execution.
All 1921 model setup calls request the disk cache, with 1915 hits. Keeping loaded pipelines and reducing provider-call count are performance targets, not established improvements.
The VM observer restores its original topology and removes both custom guest drivers. No physical driver change, NPU restart or physical reboot occurs.
Full desktop offload, usable interaction, physical scanout migration and Tahoma improvement remain unverified.
